transcript.text: I reviewed the university's master research agreement and the controlling schedule they supplied overnight. I confirmed that background patents U1, U2, and U3 are licensed to the company only for noncommercial academic use. The current draft grants the university an exclusive commercial license to all background technology used in the project, which would conflict with that restriction. The final agreement must exclude patents U1, U2, and U3 from any commercial license and require separate written university consent before any commercial use of those patents.
